text_blocks.snippet: Vascular tumors, which are growths made up of blood or lymph vessels, can present with a variety of symptoms depending on their location and type. Common symptoms include raised, red, purple, or blue skin lesions; swelling or lumps under the skin; pain or tenderness at the site; and skin discoloration. Some may also cause functional impairments depending on their location (e.g., near the eyes or airways).
